use: Set and apply security gate rules: what must pass before a change can merge or ship, with the pass and fail thresholds written out. Use when a team needs a merge or release gate.

steps.note: Read the pipeline. Open the CI configuration and note which security checks already run: static analysis, dependency checks, secret scanning and tests.
Define the gates. For each check, write the rule: block on any new high or critical finding, block on a secret, block on a dependency with a known exploit, and warn on medium findings.
Separate new from old. A gate should block on findings introduced by the change, not on every old finding.
Check the bypass path. Flag any way to skip a gate: skipped steps, allowed-to-fail flags, or an approval that is not recorded.
Check evidence. Each gate run should leave a result that can be looked up later: the commit, the tool version, the findings and the decision.
Report. List the gates as a table: check, rule, action (block or warn), owner.

protocol.title: Read the pipeline
protocol.text: Open the CI configuration and note which security checks already run: static analysis, dependency checks, secret scanning and tests.

protocol.title: Define the gates
protocol.text: For each check, write the rule: block on any new high or critical finding, block on a secret, block on a dependency with a known exploit, and warn on medium findings. Record the threshold.

protocol.title: Separate new from old
protocol.text: A gate should block on findings introduced by the change, not on every old finding. Record the baseline, and how it is updated.

protocol.title: Check the bypass path
protocol.text: Flag any way to skip a gate: skipped steps, allowed-to-fail flags, or an approval that is not recorded. Each bypass needs a named owner and an expiry.

protocol.title: Check evidence
protocol.text: Each gate run should leave a result that can be looked up later: the commit, the tool version, the findings and the decision.

protocol.title: Report
protocol.text: List the gates as a table: check, rule, action (block or warn), owner. Then list the gaps where a gate is missing. Mark what you did not run.
